datasets.name: DocLayNet
datasets.notes: Large page-layout corpus. Its object labels are auxiliary features, not PDF2MD front-page gold labels. Preserve attribution and license notices.

datasets.name: GROTOAP2
datasets.license: CC-BY (as stated by the dataset paper)
datasets.notes: Semi-automatically labelled scientific-document zones; useful as weak supervision and must not be treated as fully human-corrected gold data.

datasets.name: PMC Open Access Subset
datasets.notes: Use only official PMC retrieval services and retain each article's license metadata. Open Access membership alone does not grant one uniform training or redistribution license.

datasets.name: CompHRDoc
datasets.license: MIT for repository code/annotations; source images have separate restrictions
datasets.notes: The official repository says HRDoc-Hard images must be obtained separately because of license restrictions. Do not infer image rights from the repository's MIT license.
